title: BUSTING all the FUD! | COPI Cafe #20 | Cornucopias
description:
Busting up all of the FUD, who you gonna call?

Rob and Josh address the recent FUD in the community, some upcoming changes to the roadmap and a not so brief overview of what's been accomplished in the past year. 

We welcome back our amazing devs David and Jim to show off their latest creations that are sure to light the community Cardano community on fire.

Finishing up with a few important updates on land staking and the COPI stake pool rewards.

Be sure to check out the newly released "Custom Dome" document to learn all about our upcoming NFT mint! 

Link: https://links.cornucopias.io/custom-domes-deck-01

00:00 - Start
00:38 - Beverage Choices
01:45 - Responding to Recent Feedback
06:30 - Slight Strategy Adjustment
09:25 - FUD Campaign
16:08 - NFT Sales Review
18:55 - Custom Dome Pricing
24:28 - Cornucopias + Cardano Community
30:00 - 1-Year Deliverables
42:42 - David + Jim Join COPI Cafe
44:46 - LIVE GAMEPLAY in a Custom Dome
44:52 - Meet Wendy
59:10 - Custom Dome Sizes Overview
01:00:18 - COPI Stake Pool
01:01:12 - Land Staking Program

#Metaverse #NFT #CryptoCurrency 

Fair disclaimer: COPILeaks are brief glimpses into the game's mechanics as they currently stand. Everything we leak can be assumed to be unfinished, is subject to change, or may never be seen again. So enjoy it while you can, and be sure to share this COPILeak with everyone you know!

Epic land video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=v52pdDdPzMw

Be sure to like and subscribe to our channel for more developments from the Cornucopias metaverse project! Also, check out our social channels below:
